text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-controlled Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Zimbabwe Catholic Church tried but failed to persuade a 15-year-old girl from pressing charges that she was raped by a priest last year while four-months pregnant. The priest was sentenced to seven years in prison.

- A couple from Zimbabwe's eastern border city of Mutare was sentenced to life in jail for murdering a five-year old girl, beheading and planting her head in a relative's home. The couple said they wanted to frame the relative, so he would be arrested and jailed and they could take over his house.
